value.rationale: Distinct Abelian-square diversity is a standard repetition invariant. Three marked ones are the first odd positive weight allowing two neighboring two-one factor families with equal-gap collision. The classification resolves every word in a natural infinite fixed-composition family, produces its all-length generating series and exact conditional mean 1/40 and nondegenerate limiting law, none supplied by generic quadratic bounds.
